accepted.s: Which one of the following National Parks is located in Maharashtra and is associated with the Chandrapur district?
accepted.x: Tadoba-Andhari National Park is located in Maharashtra’s Chandrapur district and has a dry deciduous landscape.
accepted.tq: Use the state–district pair to identify the protected area.
accepted.sec: National parks → state/UT and landscape  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. Corbett National Park — Shivalik-terai landscape
2. Dudhwa National Park — Terai grassland
3. Dachigam National Park — Hangul
4. Campbell Bay National Park — Tropical evergreen island forest
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All four pairs are correctly matched. Corbett lies in the Shivalik-terai landscape, Dudhwa is a terai grassland park, Dachigam is known for Hangul, and Campbell Bay has tropical evergreen island forest.
accepted.tq: Verify each landscape or flagship-species association before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: National parks → state/UT and landscape  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Pench National Park, extending across Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra, is associated with which literary work?
o: Around the World in Eighty Days
accepted.x: Pench National Park, located in Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra, inspired Rudyard Kipling’s The Jungle Book.
accepted.tq: Link the distinctive cultural association with the geographical location.
accepted.sec: National parks → state/UT and landscape  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Neora Valley National Park — Kalimpong, West Bengal
accepted.x: Keoladeo National Park is in Bharatpur, Rajasthan, not Alwar. Sariska National Park is associated with Alwar.
accepted.tq: Detect the wrong location by separating the two Rajasthan parks.
accepted.sec: National parks → state/UT and landscape  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: Dachigam National Park in Jammu and Kashmir is noted for the Hangul, or Kashmir stag.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure flagship-species association.
accepted.sec: National parks → state/UT and landscape  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following national parks is located in the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands?
accepted.x: Campbell Bay National Park is located in Great Nicobar in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
accepted.tq: Identify the Union Territory location from the island landscape clue.
accepted.sec: National parks → state/UT and landscape  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve extends across which combination of States?
o: Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh and Odisha
accepted.x: The Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve extends across Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Karnataka.
accepted.tq: Recall the multi-State extent rather than a single-State location.
accepted.sec: Biosphere reserves → state and UNESCO MAB status  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. Nokrek Biosphere Reserve — Meghalaya
2. Simlipal Biosphere Reserve — Odisha
3. Khangchendzonga Biosphere Reserve — Sikkim
4. Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve — Andhra Pradesh
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All four pairs are correctly matched. Nokrek is in Meghalaya, Simlipal in Odisha, Khangchendzonga in Sikkim and Seshachalam in Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Check each biosphere reserve against its State before using the coded option.
accepted.sec: Biosphere reserves → state and UNESCO MAB status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following biosphere reserves is located in Arunachal Pradesh?
accepted.x: Dehang-Dibang Biosphere Reserve is located in Arunachal Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Use elimination among reserves associated with central and western India.
accepted.sec: Biosphere reserves → state and UNESCO MAB status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following biosphere reserves is spread across Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh?
accepted.x: Achanakmar-Amarkantak Biosphere Reserve extends across Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a multi-State biosphere reserve from single-State central Indian reserves.
accepted.sec: Biosphere reserves → state and UNESCO MAB status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following biosphere reserves was included in UNESCO’s World Network of Biosphere Reserves in 2018?
accepted.x: Khangchendzonga Biosphere Reserve of Sikkim was included in UNESCO’s World Network in 2018.
accepted.tq: Match the year of international recognition with the reserve.
accepted.sec: Biosphere reserves → state and UNESCO MAB status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve was established in 2010 but is not in UNESCO’s World Network of Biosphere Reserves.
accepted.tq: Separate the year of designation from the year of UNESCO recognition.
accepted.sec: Biosphere reserves → state and UNESCO MAB status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: As of the stated count, how many biosphere reserves are included in UNESCO’s World Network of Biosphere Reserves?
accepted.x: India has 18 biosphere reserves, of which 13 are included in UNESCO’s World Network and five are not yet included.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the total number from the internationally recognised subset.
accepted.sec: Biosphere reserves → state and UNESCO MAB status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT among the five Indian biosphere reserves that are not yet included in UNESCO’s World Network?
accepted.x: Agasthyamalai is included in UNESCO’s World Network, since it received recognition in 2016. The five not yet included are Manas, Dibru-Saikhowa, Dehang-Dibang, Great Rann of Kutch and Seshachalam.
accepted.tq: Find the exception by recalling the complete list of non-WNBR reserves.
accepted.sec: Biosphere reserves → state and UNESCO MAB status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Cold Desert Biosphere Reserve is located in which State?
accepted.x: The Cold Desert Biosphere Reserve is located in Himachal Pradesh and includes areas such as Pin Valley National Park, Kibber Wildlife Sanctuary and Chandratal.
accepted.tq: Use the high-altitude cold-desert landscape to identify the State.
accepted.sec: Biosphere reserves → state and UNESCO MAB status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Cold Desert Biosphere Reserve was added to UNESCO’s Man and the Biosphere Network in which year?
accepted.x: The Cold Desert was added in September 2025 at the 37th MAB-ICC meeting in Hangzhou, becoming India’s 13th site in the network.
accepted.tq: Use the precise recent year to distinguish the updated status from older information.
accepted.sec: Biosphere reserves → state and UNESCO MAB status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the funding pattern for biosphere reserves?
o: 100 per cent central funding for all biosphere reserves
60:40 for the North-Eastern States, and 90:10 for all other States
90:10 for the North-Eastern and three Himalayan States, and 60:40 for other States
accepted.x: The funding pattern is 90:10 for the North-Eastern States and three Himalayan States, and 60:40 for other States.
accepted.tq: Compare the two funding ratios with the regional categories.
accepted.sec: Biosphere reserves → state and UNESCO MAB status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT a zone of a biosphere reserve?
accepted.x: The three zones are core, buffer and transition. Extraction zone is not a recognised zone of a biosphere reserve.
accepted.tq: Identify the term outside the standard three-zone structure.
accepted.sec: Biosphere reserves → state and UNESCO MAB status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Seville Strategy associated with biosphere reserves was adopted in which year?
accepted.x: The Seville Strategy for biosphere reserves was adopted in 1995.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the policy year from the establishment years of individual reserves.
accepted.sec: Biosphere reserves → state and UNESCO MAB status  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Arrange the following biosphere reserves in chronological order of establishment:
A. Nilgiri
B. Nanda Devi
C. Gulf of Mannar
D. Pachmarhi
accepted.x: Nilgiri was established in 1986, Nanda Devi in 1988, Gulf of Mannar in 1989 and Pachmarhi in 1999.
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest item first, then arrange the remaining reserves by year.
accepted.sec: FIRST and order of establishment  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is the smallest biosphere reserve in India by area?
accepted.x: Dibru-Saikhowa is the smallest listed biosphere reserve by area, covering 765 square kilometres.
accepted.tq: Identify the minimum value among the stated area comparisons.
accepted.sec: FIRST and order of establishment  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following categories has the highest stated number of protected areas in India?
accepted.x: India has 573 wildlife sanctuaries, compared with 109 national parks, 127 conservation reserves and 75 community reserves.
accepted.tq: Compare the absolute counts across protected-area categories.
accepted.sec: Protected area counts - states with most NPs, PA share of area  [APPSC]

accepted.s: According to the stated 2026 counts, the number of National Parks and Wildlife Sanctuaries in India is respectively:
accepted.x: The stated counts are 109 National Parks and 573 Wildlife Sanctuaries. The figure 688 refers to the combined number of National Parks and Wildlife Sanctuaries in another cited count.
accepted.tq: Keep category-wise figures separate from combined totals.
accepted.sec: Protected area counts - states with most NPs, PA share of area  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with its stated count?
accepted.x: The stated counts are 127 Conservation Reserves, 75 Community Reserves, 33 Elephant Reserves and 18 Biosphere Reserves.
accepted.tq: Match each category with its exact count and reject the shifted figures.
accepted.sec: Protected area counts - states with most NPs, PA share of area  [APPSC]

accepted.s: According to the cited 29 July 2026 figure, Tiger Reserves span approximately what share of India’s area?
accepted.x: The cited figure states that Tiger Reserves span about 84,488 square kilometres, approximately 2.6 per cent of India’s area.
accepted.tq: Use the percentage attached to the stated area rather than confusing it with another dataset.
accepted.sec: Protected area counts - states with most NPs, PA share of area  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Khangchendzonga National Park was inscribed as a World Heritage Site in which year?
accepted.x: Khangchendzonga National Park in Sikkim was inscribed in 2016 and is a mixed World Heritage Site.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the inscription year from the biosphere-reserve recognition year.
accepted.sec: Natural World Heritage Sites of India  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Great Himalayan National Park — Himachal Pradesh — 2014
accepted.x: The Western Ghats World Heritage property extends across six States, not seven. It was inscribed in 2012.
accepted.tq: Check both the geographical extent and the inscription year in the long pair.
accepted.sec: Natural World Heritage Sites of India  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The World Heritage property comprising Nanda Devi and Valley of Flowers National Parks was initially inscribed in:
accepted.x: Nanda Devi and Valley of Flowers National Parks were inscribed in 1988; the property was extended in 2005.
accepted.tq: Separate the original inscription year from the later extension year.
accepted.sec: Natural World Heritage Sites of India  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Banff — South Africa — Big Five savanna
accepted.x: Serengeti National Park is in Tanzania and is famous for the great wildebeest migration.
accepted.tq: Start with the distinctive animal or landscape feature and verify the country.
accepted.sec: World-famous national parks → country and feature  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Banff National Park is located in which country and is associated with which mountain system?
accepted.x: Banff National Park is in Canada and is located in the Rocky Mountains. It was Canada’s first national park, established in 1885.
accepted.tq: Combine the country and physical-landscape clues.

accepted.s: Kruger National Park is famous as a:
o: Big Five savanna park in South Africa
Geyser park in the United States
accepted.x: Kruger National Park is located in South Africa and is known as a Big Five savanna park.
accepted.tq: Use the signature wildlife description to identify the park and country.
